probes.name: blank-growth
probes.source:
Function Report(p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim s As String,c As Range,n As Long
If p Is Nothing Then
Report="<none>"
Exit Function
End If
s=p.Name & ":cache=" & p.CacheIndex & ":range=" & p.TableRange1.Address & ":cells="
For Each c In p.TableRange1.Cells
n=n+1
If n>64 Then
s=s & "<truncated-after-64>"
Exit For
End If
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
Next
Report=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Report=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot(c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim s As String,r As Long,cell As Range
s="cache=" & c.Index & ":records=" & c.RecordCount & ":enabled=" & c.EnableRefresh & ";" & Report(p) & ";" & Report(q) & ";keys="
For r=2 To 9
s=s & CStr(Worksheets("Data").Cells(r,1).Value2) & "|"
Next
Set cell=Worksheets("Data").Range("J8")
s=s & ";J8=" & TypeName(cell.Value2) & ":" & CStr(cell.Value2)
Snapshot=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Snapshot=s & "SNAPSHOT-ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Attempt(c As PivotCache) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
c.Refresh
Attempt="completed"
Exit Function
Failed:
Attempt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable,f As PivotField,r As Long,s As String,stage As String
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="setup"
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.Calculation=-4105
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value=Array("Key","N","Tag")
For r=2 To 9
ws.Cells(r,1).Value2="A"
ws.Cells(r,2).Value2=r-1
ws.Cells(r,3).Value2="x"
Next
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:C9"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E8"),"ColumnReport")
p.PivotFields("Key").Orientation=xlColumnField
Set f=p.AddDataField(p.PivotFields("N"),"Total",xlSum)


s="before=[" & Snapshot(c,p,q) & "]"
stage="edit"
For r=2 To 9
ws.Cells(r,1).Value2="K" & CStr(r-1)
Next
s=s & ";edited=[" & Snapshot(c,p,q) & "]"
stage="refresh"
s=s & ";refresh=" & Attempt(c) & ";after=[" & Snapshot(c,p,q) & "]"
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=s & ";PROBE-ERR:" & stage & ":" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
